sights.n: Daimaru Shinsaibashi Main Building (大丸心斎橋店 本館, Vories)
sights.w: William Merrell Vories' 1933 neo-Gothic department store on Midōsuji; rebuilt 2019 reusing the original tiled façade, peacock relief and Art Deco interiors — Lmaga runs Vories architecture walks here and OSAKA-INFO lists it as a historic-architecture highlight.
